class.name: NNSTTransition
class.brief_description: Transition between active states through [method NNSTBranchNodes.send_event], [method take], or automatically on state/property changes.
class.description: Provides [member event_name], [member to] and [member delay_in_seconds] export variables to be consumed by [method NNSTBranchNodes.send_event]. The transition is performed on the parent of this node. When [member event_name] is empty the transition is automatic: it is tried when its state is entered and remains in play while that state is active. Automatic transitions are re-evaluated on the trigger types reported by their guard, never every frame.

method.name: evaluate_delay
method.description: Evaluates [member delay_in_seconds] to a non-negative number of seconds. Plain numeric strings are returned directly, otherwise the string is evaluated as an expression against the values of the root's [member NNSTRoot.blackboard]. Empty, invalid, non-numeric and negative results return [code]0.0[/code].

method.name: take
method.description: Triggers this transition from code. The parent state must be active, otherwise an error is pushed and nothing happens. When [param immediately] is [code]true[/code] the delay is skipped; when it is [code]false[/code] the delay is honored and the transition is taken once it elapses. Returns [code]true[/code] if the transition was taken or queued, and [code]false[/code] if it cannot currently be applied, for example because the [member to] target is invalid, the target is the parent state itself, or the transition is rejected because of a parallel common ancestor or an exiting lineage. The guard is not evaluated by this method.

method.name: get_supported_trigger_types
method.description: Returns a bit mask of [enum NNSTRoot.TriggerType] values that can trigger this transition. Non-automatic transitions support only [constant NNSTRoot.EVENT]. Automatic transitions always support [constant NNSTRoot.STATE_ENTER] and additionally the trigger types reported by their guard.

method.name: is_triggered_by
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if this transition can be triggered by the given [enum NNSTRoot.TriggerType] flag.

method.name: evaluate_guard
method.description: Evaluates the guard and returns [code]true[/code] if the guard is satisfied (or if there is no guard).

members.member: An expression for the delay in seconds before this transition is taken. A plain number is used directly. The expression can use the keys of the root's [member NNSTRoot.blackboard] as input names. Identifiers the expression reads are looked up in the blackboard; a key that is missing from the blackboard is passed as [code]null[/code] and is not an error. A delay on a missing key therefore falls back to [code]0.0[/code]. Invalid or negative results also fall back to [code]0.0[/code], which takes the transition immediately. While a delay is pending, [signal NNSTTickedNodes.transition_pending] is emitted on the parent state every tick, and the pending transition is cancelled when the state exits.
Case sensitive event name that will trigger this [NNSTTransition]. An empty name makes the transition automatic.
Optional condition that must be satisfied for the transition to be taken. With no guard, the transition is taken whenever it is triggered.

[NodePath] to target node. The target can also be an [NNSTHistory] child of the state this transition belongs to, for example [code]../History[/code]. In that case the state the history remembers (or its default state) is entered instead.

signal.name: taken
signal.description: Emitted when this transition is actually executed, either immediately or when its pending delay elapses. Emitted before any state exit callback. Not emitted when the transition is only queued, and not emitted for transitions that are rejected (for example an invalid target, a self-transition, or a parallel or exiting-lineage rejection).
